text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The NHK Mile Cup
was all anyone could talk about regarding Rhein Kraft!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Craft is... Ah, there she is!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Wah... how strange. Somehow the atmosphere feels a little different from a regular race...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft, huh. If I win,
does that make me the new Mile Queen or something?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Still, Craft has always felt, like...
a single blossom standing out within the Tiara, you know?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Tiara route girls have hardly ever won this race, right?
Hope she doesn't get overwhelmed."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, ahaha...
Now they're worrying about me~

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, yeah!
I trained properly, so I'll be just fine.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I'll win here...!
And blaze a brand new trail!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Seems like everyone's attention
has completely shifted to craft, huh.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Her brilliance at the Oka Sho truly was something—
even I was a little caught off guard!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"So please, just think of me as a dark horse, okay?
It will make for a far more dramatic race, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Whoa, both of them are so focused...! I should hide so I don't get in their way.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Hang in there...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching the NHK Mile Cup with bated breath!
What unfolded before our eyes—
was a fierce battle so thrilling it made everyone forget to breathe!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"In second place is Daring Heart!
The Oka Sho contenders take the lead—"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft claims victory—!
A terrifying new heroine is born!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Ah, jeez, not again...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My rival—
she just keeps going, on and on without end!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Craaaft!
That was amaaaazing!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Mile Queen!!
We're rooting for you from here on out, too!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The "New Heroine" and the "Mile Queen," huh...
As expected of you, Kraft...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on 1st place!
You truly walked the walkâwhat a wonderful race!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
There were so many firsts, and I felt a bit anxious myself...
But I was able to run with a calm mind!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I feel like... I was able to run the race I wanted to...
And that I was truly able to show my brilliance...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Line Craft, dashing through with all her might and enveloped in cheers,
became a major topic of conversation,
especially among the Tiara Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tiara Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft, that was amazing!
Switching your focus to the mile was totally the right call~.

text_block_list.name: Tiara Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Going from the Oka Sho to the NHK Mile Cup... I actually think that's a pretty solid route!

text_block_list.name: Tiara Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Right... What should I do? Maybe I should
try talking to my Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(............
The path where you "shine the brightest"... huh.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (Yes... It was magnificent. So much so that my heart is still trembling.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(...No, let's stop overthinking.
First and foremost, the Oaks!
I must devote all my focus to that.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, congratulations, Kraft.
May happiness follow wherever your path leads."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The new path carved out by Rhein Kraft—
and with that, the NHK Mile Cup drew to a close.
